title: The demo course
summary: First steps: one small course installed once, which then belongs to the learner.
description:
A fresh install needs something to practise before any key is set up. First steps / Pierwsze kroki is that: a handful of words, sentences and a short introduction dialogue. It is installed once and is the learner's from then on.

Earlier versions shipped a larger collection of built-in courses. Upgrading removes those, but only where the learner left them exactly as shipped.

requirements.text: A fresh install has exactly one course, First steps, with 12 words, 4 sentences and a 6-line dialogue.
The demo course is seeded once per install: after the learner deletes it, it does not come back.
Edits to the demo course are never overwritten by the app.
The demo course's rows have ids derived from the course and each row's place in it, so two devices that install it agree on them.
A device that joins another device's data does not seed the demo course into it again.
Upgrading removes a course from the previous built-in collection only when its content still matches what was shipped; practice progress does not count as a change.
A formerly built-in course that was edited, extended, shared with another course, or has songs or sources is kept on upgrade.
The former built-in courses are not part of production builds; they exist only as test fixtures.
